scope: For every integer p>=8, a quadratic family of explicit integral two-torsion classes forms a direct summand (Z/2)^floor(((p-2)^2+3)/12) of the specified full Koszul presentation. The complementary quotient, upper bound, isolated/relative identification and lower-strand recurrence remain open. The family-to-presentation identification is an imported premise; this is not a new disproof of the original conjecture or a Jacobian result.
